title: State-protected cultural monuments of Latvia with their dating (list of the National Heritage Board, Dec 2024; geometry from a ministry ArcGIS copy)
licence: list CC0 1.0 (data.gov.lv); the ArcGIS geometry copy states no licence — private pack
describe: Architectural, archaeological, urban and historical monuments of Latvia, each over the dating the list gives ('19. gs. 2. p.' = second half of the 19th century; archaeological periods by the conventional Latvian scheme: Early Iron Age 1–400, Middle 400–800, Late 800–1200, Middle Ages 1201–1561, early modern 1561–1795); Bronze/Stone Age datings left undated. Placed at the centre of each monument's outline.
